title: OTP Share Guard
summary: Says in one sentence what a one-time code really approves and warns hard during a call or screen share, so it's less likely to be read out to a scammer.
description: OTP display that says what the code approves ("approves a ₹24,999 payment to Croma") and, during a call or screen share or when it isn't what the user started, shows a never-share warning with hold-to-reveal, delayed Copy, a code hidden while sharing and "Not me".
catches: Code approving something other than what the user started
Active phone call or screen share while a code is shown
Code drawn on a shared screen: hidden while sharing
Quick copy under pressure: Copy is delayed
"I didn't request this" reporting in one tap
limits: Call and screen-share state must come from your app (onCall, screenSharing); the web can't detect them reliably
A determined user can still read the code aloud
Wording assumes Indian banking defaults (INR); pass your own messages
a11y: Hold-to-reveal works with Space or Enter held as well as pointer
The hidden code is aria-hidden until revealed
Warnings are text with icons aria-hidden
server: Bind each code to one action and amount, expire it quickly, and block approval when the user reports "not me".
stops: Helps stop an OTP being read out to a scammer
